spanish: Y será a ustedes a fleco, y verán a él, y recordarán todos los mandamientos de Jehová, y los harán, y no rondarán detrás de corazón de ustedes y detrás de ojos de ustedes, que ustedes fornicantes detrás de ellos,

findings.issue: H8446 qal imperfect 2mp is seek, spy, or explore; rondarán adds circling or patrolling.
אַחֲרֵי is after or following as well as behind; detrás de leans to a place behind.

notes: Ustedes futures match the 2mp verbs; dual eyes as ojos and יהוה as Jehová stay inside the tokens.
